title: LinePull coordinates for smooth purity
statement: Use [def-pur-transport-derived-coordinates]. A system of line pullback coordinates for $f:X\to Y$ consists of an integral line isomorphism commuting with every finite root-tower projection and its root-normalized comparison, its scalar extension to the coefficient $c$ fixed by scalar transport, and the power comparisons fixed by the recursive monoidal construction for every $d\ge0$. The derived comparison is induced by these ordinary comparisons. Such a system exists when $\ell$ is invertible on $X,Y$. No root frame is selected.

source.place: Coefficient, functor, counit and normalization clauses; coordinate interface TransportLinePull

proof.text: Apply integralComparison from [def-pur-transport-canonical-pullback] to f. Its existence clause supplies the integral isomorphism and all root-normalized finite comparisons together with the projection equations.
Define the first coefficient-line comparison to be scalarPull of the integral isomorphism along the integral coefficient map. Its normalization is reflexive heterogeneous equality.

For every scheme Z, prove by induction on d that its coefficient line equals the Nat.rec tensor-power expression: reflexivity at zero and congruence under tensoring with the first line at the successor. Rewrite both endpoints of powerPull from [def-pur-transport-tensor-coordinates] using these equalities. This gives a power comparison heterogeneously equal to powerPull. Choose these normalized comparisons for all d and package the fields in LinePullCoordinates. At d=0 powerPull uses the inverse unit tensorator.

proof_origin.place: Canonical coefficient pullback comparisons, implemented from the existing integralComparison, scalarPull and powerPull interfaces.
